name: Pepper
summary: Pepper is a humanoid robot from SoftBank Robotics. SoftBank Robotics America describes it as "a robot designed for people. Built to connect with them, assist them, and share knowledge with them" and lists retail, banking, education, hospitality and healthcare applications. Specifications, maturity and current availability have not yet been verified.

variants.name: Pepper for Home 2.0 (home rental model, Japan)

pricing_offers.price_basis: Monthly rental fee including tax; the lowest plan, the 1-year contract basic plan (基本プラン（1年契約）); round-trip shipping free
pricing_offers.note: FROM, as the store presents it ('月額39,800円（税抜）/43,780円（税込）からレンタルできます'): 43,780 yen per month including tax on the 1-year plan. The month-to-month basic plan (基本プラン（月額）, minimum one month) is 76,780 yen per month including tax; one price row per offer key, so it is recorded here, not as a second row. Not a purchase price.

evidence.source_title: Pepper for Home 2.0 レンタル 基本プラン（1年契約） — Kauriru rental mall store operated by TENT Inc. (Japan)

Store 'Pepper for Home 2.0' on the Kauriru rental mall, operated by 株式会社TENT (TENT Inc., Minato-ku, Tokyo; store contact prj-sbrtent-pepper@tent-inc.jp). SoftBank's own Pepper purchase page (https://www.softbank.jp/robot/consumer/buy/, sha256 7caae18720431455f90b4659ff63bf6cb70fbf81cb59e628ae3dcf7968671b92) says 'Pepper(一般販売モデル)の販売は終了しました。' and links 'Pepper for Home レンタルプランのお申し込みはこちら' to this store, which is the authorization basis recorded. RENTAL only: the plan page says '※レンタル後の購入不可' (no purchase after rental); it is never a purchase offer. Edition: the home model 'Pepper for Home 2.0', pinned by the variant; business models are referred to SoftBank Robotics. Japan only: '海外でのご利用については想定しておりません'; remote islands may not be served.

spec_caveats.text: SoftBank Robotics states 'Height (mm) Width (mm) Depth (mm) 1210 480 425' (http://doc.aldebaran.com/2-5/family/pepper_technical/dimensions_pep.html). Aldebaran/SoftBank Robotics Pepper technical documentation (NAOqi 2.5), arms-down height; 1210 mm = 121 cm.
SoftBank Robotics states 'Leg Wheel center, at floor level' (http://doc.aldebaran.com/2-5/family/pepper_technical/bodyparts_pep.html).
SoftBank Robotics states 'Pepper QiSDK [ Pepper SDK for Android ]' (http://doc.aldebaran.com/index.html).

SoftBank Robotics states 'NAOqi Python - API' (http://doc.aldebaran.com/2-5/dev/programming_index.html). NAOqi programming API documentation for SoftBank Robotics robots (NAOqi 2.5 doc set covering Pepper).

SoftBank Robotics states 'It runs on a desktop and is able to communicate with all the Aldebaran robots.' (http://doc.aldebaran.com/2-5/dev/ros/index_ros.html). The NAOqi ROS documentation states the ROS driver works with all Aldebaran robots, Pepper included.

Aldebaran/SoftBank Robotics Pepper joint list: 'LHand Left hand Open and Close' (one joint per hand) (http://doc.aldebaran.com/2-5/family/pepper_technical/joints_pep.html). DEC-07: standard hand, one actuated joint.
